content: पृच् I. €2 <ab>Ā.</ab> (पृक्ते, पृक्ण) To come in contact with. --II. €7 <ab>P.</ab> (पृणक्ति, पृक्त) .²1 To bring into contact with, join, unite; एवं वदन् दाशरथिरपृणग्धनुषा शरम् <ls>Bk. 6. 39</ls>. .²2 To mix, mingle. .²3 To be in contact with, touch. .²4 To satisfy, fill, satiate. .²5 To augment, increase, .²6 <ab>Ved.</ab> To give or grant bountifully. --III. €1 <ab>P.</ab>, €10 <ab>U.</ab> (पर्चति, पर्चयति-ते) .²1 To touch, come in contact with. .²2 To hinder, oppose.
